visualReview.notes: Actually inspected 95 final images: 18 portable, 18 shared-material, 34 medium-fi and 25 signed terrain images. Actual official tourist-board aerial, southwest/Crown view, south portal photograph and Baroque garden photograph were inspected, along with both pages of the 2023 brochure and page13 of the NR SR2018 proposal. Four palace wings surround the roofless court; unequal square/octagonal towers and swept terracotta crowns, five-story window rhythm, south triple portals/curved pavilions, separate barracks/riding hall, mapped garden/parterre/fountain, low archaeological foundations and four independent gates remain recognizable. Three gate bearings were transverse to mapped passages and are corrected in the derivative. Original hillside field is removed; civil levels are fitted individually. Figurative garden statues, underground spaces, mature trees and interiors are outside this exterior scope. The Svátopluk silhouette is interpretive. Fine bay/window counts, ornament and gate body envelopes remain approximate.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six common graphs provide granite foundations, lime plaster, wood, painted metal, ceramic tile and gravel. Carved white trim shares tinted plaster; bronze sculpture shares painted metal; dark dormer/clock recesses share the opaque glass slot. Foliage tint is local without images. Actual shared images show pale warm walls, orange roofs with ceramic courses, dark joinery and coherent greenery. Duplicate roof-course geometry is removed in favor of the shared ceramic texture. Six GLBs contain zero images. Skyline bakes common linear material means in one draw. Common graphs are read once in the terrain fixture and model geometry is disposed on unload. The flat shared geographic fixture verifies signed horizontal placement only; numeric terrain is tested independently. No reference photograph is redistributed.

mediumFiReview.notes: All 34 final style images inspected: noon/late light, economy/high modes, architecture/gate cameras, whole-model levels and transitions. Skyline retains four towers, open court, pavilions, barracks, garden platform and four open gate silhouettes at 984 triangles. District adds representative window rhythm/shared surfaces at 3885 triangles; street adds openings, dormers, court buttresses and paths at 15630; close-up restores trim/mullions, clocks, urns, parterre hedges, fountain and original horse/rider interpretation at 57728. Window bay density and minor path sampling fade with distance while silhouette/material means remain coherent. Retained review terrain is diagnostic ground; the broader city and generic context are not source geometry. Strict medium-fi reports no findings.

terrainReview.notes: Actually inspected all 25 final normal-placement terrain images: original derivative and four browser levels each show the whole castle plus Vienna, Sigismund, Nicholas and Leopold passages. Gates remain open, approach decks fit this retained terrain, sampled palace retaining faces meet grade, and the park remains host ground. Garden is an interpreted flat upper platform; its large eastern retaining face reflects unresolved coarse terrain/terrace levels. This is accepted medium-fi exterior scope, not a survey or fit to arbitrary host terrain. Signed normal renderer, numeric reference, three exposed retaining feet, twelve gate rays per level and five unloads are hash-bound. Other buried feet and civil path detail are visible checks, not exhaustive numerical tests.
